schema_sql: CREATE TABLE notes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, label TEXT, qty INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, dept_id INTEGER, salary INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE departments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)
CREATE TABLE org_chart (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, manager_id INTEGER)
data_sql: INSERT INTO notes (id, label, qty) VALUES (1, 'apple', 3), (2, 'banana', 7), (3, 'cherry', 2), (4, 'date', 5)
INSERT INTO employees (id, name, dept_id, salary) VALUES (1, 'alice', 10, 90000), (2, 'bob', 20, 75000), (3, 'carol', 10, 110000), (4, 'dave', 30, 60000)
INSERT INTO org_chart (id, name, manager_id) VALUES (1, 'ceo', 0), (2, 'vp_eng', 1), (3, 'vp_sales', 1), (4, 'eng_lead', 2), (5, 'sales_lead', 3)

cases.name: filter_by_label
cases.sql: SELECT id, label, qty FROM notes WHERE label = 'banana'

cases.name: range_filter
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM notes WHERE qty >= 3 AND qty <= 6 ORDER BY id

cases.name: aggregate_count
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM notes

cases.name: order_limit
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM notes ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT 2

cases.name: in_list
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM notes WHERE label IN ('apple', 'cherry') ORDER BY id

cases.name: between
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM notes WHERE qty BETWEEN 3 AND 5 ORDER BY id

cases.name: group_by_aggregate
cases.sql: SELECT dept_id, count(*) AS n FROM employees GROUP BY dept_id ORDER BY dept_id

cases.name: inner_join
cases.sql: SELECT e.name AS emp, d.name AS dept FROM employees AS e INNER JOIN departments AS d ON e.dept_id = d.id ORDER BY e.id

cases.name: recursive_cte_org_chart
cases.sql: WITH RECURSIVE up(id, name, depth) AS (SELECT id, name, 1 AS depth FROM org_chart WHERE manager_id = 0 UNION ALL SELECT o.id, o.name, t.depth + 1 FROM org_chart AS o INNER JOIN up AS t ON o.manager_id = t.id) SELECT name, depth FROM up ORDER BY depth, name
